description: Source code for the TimedTextDriver class in Android's media stagefright framework, managing timed text tracks, including adding sources, track selection, and control functions.

classes.name: TimedTextDriver
classes.description: Manages timed text tracks, including adding sources, track selection, and playback control.

methods.name: selectTrack_l
methods.description: Internal method to select a timed text source track.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts playback of the selected timed text track.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses playback of the timed text.

methods.name: selectTrack
methods.description: Selects a specific timed text track, handling pause/resume as needed.

methods.name: unselectTrack
methods.description: Unselects the current track and resets state.

methods.name: seekToAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously seeks to a specified timestamp.

methods.name: addInBandTextSource
methods.description: Adds an in-band timed text source.

methods.name: addOutOfBandTextSource
methods.description: Adds an out-of-band timed text source from URI or file descriptor.

methods.name: createOutOfBandTextSource
methods.description: Creates a timed text source from a data source and mime type.

methods.name: countExternalTracks
methods.description: Counts the number of external (out-of-band) timed text tracks.

methods.name: getExternalTrackInfo
methods.description: Retrieves info about external timed text tracks.
